data.description:
# munitoai-free rate_limit_rpm: 15 — 24h observation check-in

discovered-from:LP-0MVDVJYN5001BMG4

## Goal (user story)

As the proxy operator, I want a 24-hour post-change verification that the new
`rate_limit_rpm: 15` on `munitoai-free` (raised from 10 by
LP-0MVDVJYN5001BMG4) does **not** drive the third-party free tier into
sustained upstream 429s, and that the predicted paid-spill reduction actually
materialises — with an explicit rollback trigger if it does not.

## Context

- LP-0MVDVJYN5001BMG4 measured the pre-change state: at `rate_limit_rpm: 10`
  the free-tier spill was ~45 % of arrivals at peak demand (2.5 h window,
  p95 32 arrivals/min), paid (opencode.ai) share ~46 % of remote dispatches,
  upstream 429s 2 in 2.5 h (0.17 % of free dispatches). The pre-gate 429 onset
  was ≈20 dispatches/rolling-60 s (429-minute rate: 4–6 % at ≤19/min, 20 % at
  20–29, 47 % at 30–39, 100 % ≥40). The what-if simulation at capacity 15
  predicted spill ≈27 %.
- The value was changed to 15 in `proxy/config.yaml` and `proxy/config-fast.yaml`
  (all three chains: plan / author / code) with `provider_rate_limit_reserve_ratio: 0.3`
  unchanged → new-session effective cap now **11**, affinity cap **15**.
- The change takes effect at the **next proxy restart** (T0). It was NOT
  restarted as part of LP-0MVDVJYN5001BMG4; the observation window starts at
  whichever restart first carries the new config. If the restart has not
  happened, this check-in must wait and re-schedule rather than measure the old
  config.
- Reproducible measurement tool: `proxy/benchmarks/munitoai_budget_eval.py`
  (committed with LP-0MVDVJYN5001BMG4).

## Evaluation method (24 h observation window [T0, T0+24h])

1. **Restart marker:** find the first `Proxy restart attribution:` (or
   `Logging initialised at`) line in `/var/log/llama-proxy/proxy.log` after the
   LP-0MVDVJYN5001BMG4 commit/push; that is T0. If none exists, wait (the change
   is not live).
2. **Upstream 429s:** count
   `upstream error status=429 url=https://api.munito.ai` lines in [T0, T0+24h).
   Report absolute count, per hour, and as a share of munitoai dispatches
   (`[remote] POST … -> https://api.munito.ai/inference`).
3. **Rollback trigger:** if the upstream-429 *minute* rate at peak demand
   (≥ 20 free arrivals in a rolling-60 s) exceeds ~10 % of minutes, or any
   sustained multi-minute 429 burst occurs, **revert to 10** (config + fixtures +
   tests + docs, mirroring the change in LP-0MVDVJYN5001BMG4) and record why.
4. **Spill confirmation:** run
   `python3 proxy/benchmarks/munitoai_budget_eval.py` over the window and report
   the measured spill share at capacity 15 (expected ≈27 %, vs 45 % at 10) and
   the paid (opencode.ai) share of remote dispatches.
5. **Latency:** confirm waits stay ≤ 15 s (0 waits > 15 s) and MunitoAI
   first-token p90/p95/p99 does not rise vs the pre-change baseline.
6. Post the measurement table on this item (AC1-equivalent) and, when all
   rollback conditions are clear, mark it `in_review`/`completed`.

## Acceptance Criteria

1. The measured upstream-429 rate over [T0, T0+24h) is reported (absolute,
   per-hour, share of dispatches) with an explicit pass/fail against the
   rollback trigger.
2. The measured spill share and paid-tier share are reported and compared to
   the LP-0MVDVJYN5001BMG4 predictions (≈27 % spill at 15).
3. Latency (wait distribution ≤ 15 s; free-tier first-token p50/p90/p95/p99) is
   reported and compared to baseline.
4. An explicit verdict is recorded: keep 15 / revert to 10 / adjust further,
   with the evidence, and the item advanced to `in_review`.
5. If the verdict is revert/adjust, the config, fixtures, tests and docs are
   updated in a worktree and the full project test suite passes (via the test
   skill).

## Constraints

- Do not restart the proxy from this session; if the config is not yet live,
  wait and re-schedule rather than measuring stale state.
- Test runs go through the test skill; never drive the free tier into sustained
  429s to probe.
- Read-only on production state except the revert path (AC5), which is its own
  approved change.
